verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation such as webhooks, triggers or scheduled agents is a plausible capability for an AI API platform, so this axis applies. However, the evidence never documents user-defined rules that fire actions on events. Function calling (gemini-docs-3) lets the model decide when to call tools within a request, which is not a rule-based event trigger. The Batch API and background execution are asynchronous processing, not event rules.
